controls.target: det(D)=-2 d_*^3; H_D=0; exact inverse relation remains defined.

exclusions: No finite-boost observational equality from defining h1_lin.
quantifiers: For every real symmetric 3x3 matrix D with det(D)!=0 and every beta in R^3.

controls.target: The quotient definition is excluded; do not evaluate it after denominator cancellation.

exclusions: No O(||beta||^2) truncation error with fixed arbitrary nonzero shear.
components.minimal_domain_note: det(D)!=0 is not required for this identity; require it additionally to compare with an exact inverse.
quantifiers: For every real symmetric 3x3 matrix D with H_D=tr(D)/3 != 0 and every beta in R^3.

exclusions: This denominator-free identity does not define an inverse estimator at H_D=0.
quantifiers: For every real H_D, real symmetric trace-free 3x3 matrix Sigma, and beta in R^3.

exclusions: No catalogue input, geodesicity, finite-distance extrapolation or measured D accuracy is supplied.

quantifiers: D is a fixed invertible real symmetric 3x3 matrix.
components.separate_unproved_input: Deriving the physical Taylor remainder, its domain b0 and constant C from the exact observer/source relation is a separate analytic task, not a consequence of this conditional target.

definitions: B_0 and slope_0 are the same definitions evaluated at chi=0

degenerate_control.target: B_chi u_chi=0; chi no longer changes B_chi.

exclusions: A slope-difference identity alone does not certify the defining tensor family or its geodesicity.
No dust Einstein realization or global homogeneous geometry is asserted.
quantifiers: chi real; epsilon>0; b2>0; b3>0; n in R^3 with n dot n=1.

exclusions: Do not use an aggregate slope-residual zero alone as the check for the complete family target.
quantifiers: Use the same positive epsilon, b2,b3 and real chi domain as PROPOSED-CAS03-C02-GEODESIC-FAMILY.
targets: The gate must reject B_wrong as a realization of the prescribed geodesic family even if its chi-baseline slope difference agrees.

exclusions: L=0, negative endpoints and intervals crossing zero are outside this theorem.
This target does not construct an interval from observations, prove coverage, or validate the other CAS-13 components.
A new proof cannot inherit an old axis PASS merely from using the same formula.
quantifiers: For every real L,U with 0<L<=U, and every real predictor a.
components.scope_alignment: These three targets match the archived grstat_cas13_minimax theorem. Together they imply minimax optimality. Predictor uniqueness and the endpoint-max formula for every predictor are not additional obligations in this repair.

assumptions: For every a in R^n, abs(transpose(a) e)^2 <= 2 epsilon transpose(a) R a.
definitions: Rdagger is the real symmetric Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse: invert each positive eigenvalue of R and keep zero eigenvalues zero.
exclusions: No inverse(R) substitution on singular branches.
The residual Gram matrix is not an observational noise covariance.
No continuum Hessian-envelope, Bregman/Taylor integral or physical derivative bound follows from this finite target.
Do not require epsilon>0 or silently divide by epsilon.
This child target does not certify CAS-11-C01, CAS-11-C03 or the complete original contract.
quantifiers: n is a positive integer; V is any finite-dimensional real inner-product space.
r_1,...,r_n are arbitrary vectors in V; e is any vector in R^n; epsilon>=0.

conventions.counterexamples_scope: A domain or implementation control is not a counterexample to a differently scoped exact theorem.
